summary: Server route tests prove capabilities advertise an available, previewable Empirical adapter and golden-policy tests prove no Empirical executable or package dependency exists.
Canonical fixture and route tests prove schema-4 preview fields, deterministic sha256 revision, sorted capabilities, design/task counts, and diagnostics.
Importer tests cover stable rendering and preservation of every ADDED, MODIFIED, and REMOVED Requirement and Scenario with capability provenance.
Importer and route tests prove optional design and serial plan-task extraction while evidence, decisions, events, locks, and runtime state are excluded from normalized content and revision material.
Route integration proves preview is read-only and a changed expected revision returns source_revision_changed before any Agentum aggregate or repository artifact is allocated.
Adversarial importer tests pass for unsafe paths, schema/state/delta errors, UTF-8, unknown shapes, limits, symlinks, locks, and parent replacement races.
Focused component/model tests and the complete 6,472-test UI suite prove source gating, typed payload, preview fields, diagnostics, and revision-bound creation.
Chromium interaction with the exported production NewSpecDialog passed all nine Empirical selection, path, preview-summary, capability, design, and diagnostic assertions with zero console errors.
The captured 1440x1200 dialog visibly shows Empirical selected, the canonical feature path, immutable sha256 revision, one capability, three tasks, design availability, and both boundary diagnostics.
Golden-policy tests bind fixture hashes and the upstream commit and assert the documented local artifact-intake, immutable preview/create, dependency-free, non-runtime, and non-export boundary.

Existing source tests, repository boundary/policy tests, server clippy, full UI typecheck and 6,472-test suite, and production build pass without changing provider, approval, evidence, or Deliver boundaries.
